narrNote: MARR is listed on NARR's official affiliates page (narronline.org/affiliates) and states on its homepage that it is the sole Michigan statewide affiliate of NARR. Name note: materials through ~2020 used 'Michigan Association of Recovery Residences'; the current NARR listing and the organization's own site use 'Michigan Association of Recovery Resources, Inc.' Verified in-run 2026-10-22.
notes: MDHHS is Michigan's single state authority for substance use; services are delivered regionally by 10 Prepaid Inpatient Health Plans (PIHPs) and 46 Community Mental Health Services Programs (CMHSPs) covering all 83 counties — the CMHAM directory linked lists each CMHSP with the counties it serves and access numbers. Medicaid specialty SUD services are covered under Michigan's Section 1115 Behavioral Health Demonstration (CMS listing linked) and administered through the PIHPs. MiCAL (1-844-446-4225) is the state's 24/7 crisis and access line and also answers Michigan's 988 calls; the peer-run Michigan Warmline operates daily 10 a.m.-2 a.m. at 888-733-7753. Agency phone is MDHHS's published main number from department letterhead.
